subject: Priors for bivariate area-level random effect model

messages.author: 84799cd2e00b1b8d
messages.subject: Priors for bivariate area-level random effect model
parts:
Hi,

I am running a couple of bivariate models, and I had some questions on the prior specification.

Model 1 uses the "group statement" 

yy = c(yy1, yy2)
intercept = as.factor(rep(1:2, each  = nrow(data)))
region.unstruct = rep(1:nrow(data), 2)
region.struct = rep(1:nrow(data), 2)
g.u = rep(1:2, each = nrow(data))
g.v = g.u
samplesize = c(samplesize1, samplesize2)

formula = yy ~ -1 + intercept +
        f(region.struct, model="besag", graph=graph.loc, group = g.u) +
        f(region.unstruct, model="iid", group = g.v)

mod <- inla(formula, family = "binomial", data = data.frame(intercept, region.unstruct, region.struct, yy ,g.u, g.v, samplesize), 
Ntrials=samplesize, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1),
control.fixed=list(prec.intercept=1), control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))


Model 2 uses the "copy" statement

yy = c(yy1, yy2)
intercept = as.factor(rep(1:2, each  = nrow(data)))
region.unstruct = rep(1:nrow(data), 2)
region.struct1 = c(1:nrow(data), rep(NA, nrow(data)))
region.struct2 = c(rep(NA, nrow(data)), 1:nrow(data))
samplesize = c(samplesize1, samplesize2)

formula = yy ~ -1 + intercept +
        f(region.struct1, model="besag", graph=graph.loc) +
        f(region.struct2, model="besag", copy="region.struct1", fixed=F) +
        f(region.unstruct, model="iid2d", n = length(samplesize))

mod <- inla(formula, family = "binomial", data = data.frame(intercept, region.unstruct, region.struct1, yy , region.struct2, samplesize), 
Ntrials=samplesize, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1),
control.fixed=list(prec.intercept=1), control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))

Model 3 uses the correlated random effects models, by Palmí Perales, Gomez-Rubio and Martinez-Beneito.

yy = c(yy1, yy2)
intercept = as.factor(rep(1:2, each  = nrow(data)))
region.unstruct = rep(1:nrow(data), 2)
region.struct = c(1:length(yy))
samplesize = c(samplesize1, samplesize2)

model_IMCAR = inla.rgeneric.define(inla.rgeneric.IMCAR.model, k=2, W=W.matrix)

formula = yy ~ -1 + intercept + f(region.struct, model=model_IMCAR) +
        f(region.unstruct, model="iid2d", n = length(samplesize))

mod <- inla(formula, family = "binomial", data = data.frame(intercept, region.unstruct, region.struct, yy, samplesize), 
Ntrials=samplesize, control.predictor=list(compute=TRUE,link=1),
control.fixed=list(prec.intercept=1), control.compute=list(dic=TRUE))


The models run fine, but given that I am only using the default priors right now, I want to do a sensitivity analysis. And I am not sure which priors are used for the models (or how to change them for the last model).
Are they Gamma priors or Wishart priors?

Thanks in advance!
K
